name: Denali & the Interior
about: Summer (Jun–Aug) is bear-viewing and hiking season; winter (Oct–Apr) is a completely different trip built around Fairbanks' aurora viewing, among the most reliable in the world.
overview: North America's tallest peak, grizzly bears and caribou on the open tundra, and Fairbanks — one of the most reliable places on Earth to see the aurora — Alaska's continental interior.
costOverview: Fairbanks and Denali stay a bit more affordable than coastal Alaska's cruise towns — the real splurge is a dedicated aurora tour or a Denali flightseeing trip.

specialSeasons.text: Peak wildlife-viewing season on the tundra, timed to the salmon runs.
Long, dark nights make this aurora season, and Fairbanks is one of the most reliable aurora-viewing spots on Earth — a completely different trip from summer's wildlife viewing.
